headline: Manifest text verification locally accepted; full release remains pending.

items.title: Manifest-based known-text parity
items.insight: Public portfolio and audit JSON can now be selected through the committed deployment manifest without downloading binary assets. The legacy default stays compatible. Actual HTTP regressions and independent review passed; full production acceptance remains pending.
